title: MONEY-MONEY
description: Adds a simple money system to Minecraft. Earn money from mobs and use 100 / 1,000 / 10,000 bills with a control book.
body:
This datapack adds a simple money system to Minecraft.

You can use 100, 1,000, and 10,000 money bills.
A special book allows you to manage your money and withdraw bills.

To get the money control book, run:
 /function money-1.21.1:money_books

You can earn money by killing mobs.
The amount you receive depends on the strength of the mob.

- Weak mobs (such as pigs) give small amounts of money
- Strong mobs give larger rewards
  - For example, the Ender Dragon gives 100,000 money

This datapack requires an additional resource pack to display custom bill textures.
Please make sure to enable the resource pack.

⚠️ This project is a demo version.
Balance and features may change in future updates.

Feedback and test play are welcome.
